I\'ve got another for you.","questMoonstoneTrophyName":"Over the Moon","questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyDescription":"Iron, gold, diamond... and now moonstone, neighbour! For a Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] I need 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] from across the broken bridge in Cragrock Mines, and 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] to make it glow like the moon.","questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyWaitingOn":"I\'ve a shining idea for a Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]], neighbour! Its Moonstone [[Moonstone]] grows past the broken bridge in Cragrock Mines, and only Grubnik\'s cannons can fire you over. Pay Grubnik his fee and he\'ll send you flying!","questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyCompleted":"Four trophies, shining like the night sky! Your shelf is the talk of the islands, neighbour.","questMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneGatherName":"Mine 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] Across the Broken Bridge","questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneGatherDescription":"Ride Grubnik\'s cannon over the broken bridge in Cragrock Mines, and mine the Moonstone Ore [[Moonstone Ore]] on the far wall until you have 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]]. A Pure Moonstone Ore [[Pure Moonstone Ore]] is slower to mine but gives 9 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] at once. Your Cracked Rubellite Pickaxe [[Cracked Rubellite Pickaxe]] mines Moonstone [[Moonstone]] from both, as does an Iron Pickaxe [[Iron Pickaxe]] or better, but a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]] gives you the ore itself instead.","questMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneHandInName":"Bring 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] to Spencer","questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneHandInDescription":"Bring the 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Moonstone [[Moonstone]] to go! Grubnik\'s cannon fires you over the broken bridge in Cragrock Mines to the Moonstone Ore [[Moonstone Ore]].","questMoonstoneTrophyLanternsGatherName":"Craft 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] at Your Artisan Bench [[Artisan Bench]]","questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyLanternsGatherDescription":"Craft 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] at the Artisan Bench [[Artisan Bench]] on your island. A little light makes moonstone shine!","questMoonstoneTrophyLanternsHandInName":"Bring 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] to Spencer","questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyLanternsHandInDescription":"Bring the 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyLanternsReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Lanterns [[Lantern]] to go! Craft them at the Artisan Bench [[Artisan Bench]] on your island.","questMakeMoonstoneTrophyName":"Get Your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] from Spencer","questSpencerMakeMoonstoneTrophyDescription":"Come and see me on your island, and I\'ll hand over your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]].","questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyMade":"Pale as a full moon! Here\'s your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]], neighbour. It\'ll catch the moonlight all night long.","questPlaceMoonstoneTrophyName":"Place the Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] on Your Island","questSpencerPlaceMoonstoneTrophyDescription":"Set your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] down on your island, beside your other trophies. Lost it? I\'ve got another for you.","questForgeBannerName":"Banner of the Forge","questSpencerForgeBannerDescription":"My trophies show off what you gather, neighbour, but a real hero needs banners for the bosses they beat! Bring down the Forge Warden in Skullforge, or tell me if you already have, and I\'ll paint you a Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] to prove it.","questBeatForgeBossName":"Beat the Forge Warden in Skullforge","questSpencerBeatForgeBossDescription":"Go through the dungeon portal in the Hub, use Skullforge\'s statue in the dungeon hall, and beat the Forge Warden at the end of the dungeon. Any difficulty counts!","questFetchForgeBannerName":"Get Your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] from Spencer","questSpencerFetchForgeBannerDescription":"Come and see me on your island, and I\'ll paint your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]].","questSpencerForgeBannerPainted":"You beat the Forge Warden! Here\'s your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]], neighbour. Careful, the paint\'s still wet!","questPlaceForgeBannerName":"Put Up the Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] on Your Island","questSpencerPlaceForgeBannerDescription":"Hang your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] on a wall or stand it on the ground, anywhere on your island. Lost it? I\'ve got another for you.","questSpencerForgeBannerCompleted":"Your first banner, flying high! Everyone who visits will know you beat the Forge Warden, neighbour.","questFrostBannerName":"Banner of the Frost","questSpencerFrostBannerDescription":"Your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] needs some company, neighbour! Beat the Frost Wraith in Frozen Hollow, or tell me if you already have, and I\'ll paint you a Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]] to go with it. Fair warning: it\'s tougher than the Forge Warden!","questBeatFrostBossName":"Beat the Frost Wraith in Frozen Hollow","questSpencerBeatFrostBossDescription":"Go through the dungeon portal in the Hub, use Frozen Hollow\'s statue in the dungeon hall, and beat the Frost Wraith at the end of the dungeon. Any difficulty counts!","questFetchFrostBannerName":"Get Your Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]] from Spencer","questSpencerFetchFrostBannerDescription":"Come and see me on your island, and I\'ll paint your Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]].","questSpencerFrostBannerPainted":"You beat the Frost Wraith! Here\'s your Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]], neighbour. I painted it so frosty, I needed mittens!","questPlaceFrostBannerName":"Put Up the Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]] on Your Island","questSpencerPlaceFrostBannerDescription":"Hang your Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]] on a wall or stand it on the ground, anywhere on your island. It\'ll look best beside your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]]! Lost it? I\'ve got another for you.","questSpencerFrostBannerCompleted":"Two banners flying! The Forge Warden and the Frost Wraith, both beaten. What a hero you are, neighbour!","questWildBannerName":"Banner of the Wilds","questSpencerWildBannerDescription":"Two banners up, neighbour, and the wilds are calling! The Tiki Terror in Wildwood Grove is the toughest boss yet! Beat it, or tell me if you already have, and I\'ll paint you a Green Banner [[Green Banner]] as leafy as the grove itself.","questBeatWildBossName":"Beat the Tiki Terror in Wildwood Grove","questSpencerBeatWildBossDescription":"Go through the dungeon portal in the Hub, use Wildwood Grove\'s statue in the dungeon hall, and beat the Tiki Terror at the end of the dungeon. Any difficulty counts!","questFetchWildBannerName":"Get Your Green Banner [[Green Banner]] from Spencer","questSpencerFetchWildBannerDescription":"Come and see me on your island, and I\'ll paint your Green Banner [[Green Banner]].","questSpencerWildBannerPainted":"You beat the Tiki Terror! Here\'s your Green Banner [[Green Banner]], neighbour, as green as a fresh spring leaf.","questPlaceWildBannerName":"Put Up the Green Banner [[Green Banner]] on Your Island","questSpencerPlaceWildBannerDescription":"Hang your Green Banner [[Green Banner]] on a wall or stand it on the ground, anywhere on your island, beside your other banners. Lost it? I\'ve got another for you.","questSpencerWildBannerCompleted":"Three banners for three bosses! Your island looks like a real hall of heroes now, neighbour.","questCoalSeamName":"A Seam of Coal","questSpencerCoalSeamDescription":"Neighbour, what if your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grew Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] as well as Stone [[Stone]]? Old Smudge works the coal quarry in Cragrock Mines, and nobody knows coal like he does. Go and ask him how it gets into rock!","questSpencerCoalSeamWaitingOn":"I\'ve a bright idea for your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]], neighbour, but it needs coal from Cragrock Mines. Ruby at Ruby\'s Rockpile in the Hub can show you the way there!","questSpencerCoalSeamCompleted":"Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] growing right here at home, neighbour! Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] are full of surprises now.","questCoalSeamMeetSmudgeName":"Ask Old Smudge in Cragrock Mines About Coal [[Coal]]","questSpencerCoalSeamMeetSmudgeDescription":"Find Old Smudge at the top of the coal quarry in Cragrock Mines\' entrance yard, and ask him how coal gets into rock.","questSpencerCoalSeamMeetSmudgeNext":"That\'s the coal sorted, neighbour! Now pop over to Old Smudge in Cragrock Mines and ask him how it gets into rock.","questCoalSeamCoalGatherName":"Gather 32 Coal [[Coal]]","questSpencerCoalSeamCoalGatherDescription":"Mine the Pure Coal Ore [[Pure Coal Ore]] in Old Smudge\'s coal quarry in Cragrock Mines until you have 32 Coal [[Coal]].","questCoalSeamCoalHandInName":"Bring 32 Coal [[Coal]] to Spencer","questSpencerCoalSeamCoalHandInDescription":"Bring the 32 Coal [[Coal]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerCoalSeamCoalReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]] to go! Old Smudge\'s coal quarry in Cragrock Mines is full of it.","questCoalSeamUpgradeName":"Have Spencer Seed Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with Coal [[Coal]]","questSpencerCoalSeamUpgradeDescription":"Come and see me on your island, and I\'ll seed your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with the Coal [[Coal]].","questSpencerCoalSeamUpgraded":"A sprinkle of Coal [[Coal]] in each, a good stir... done! Get mining, neighbour, and watch for the first dark speckles of Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]].","questCoalSeamMineName":"Mine 4 Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] Grown by Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]]","questSpencerCoalSeamMineDescription":"Stay on your island and mine 4 Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] as your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow it. About one block in five they grow is coal now! Lost your generators? I\'ve got another for you.","questIronSeamName":"Iron in the Stone","questSpencerIronSeamDescription":"That coal was only the start, neighbour! Let\'s teach your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] to grow iron too. Bring me 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] to seed them with, and 16 Coal [[Coal]] to keep them warm.","questSpencerIronSeamCompleted":"Iron and coal from your very own island! What a clever pair of generators you have, neighbour.","questIronSeamIronBarsGatherName":"Smelt 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]","questSpencerIronSeamIronBarsGatherDescription":"Mine Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] in Cragrock Mines, where a Pure Iron Ore [[Pure Iron Ore]] gives plenty, and smelt the Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]] into 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] with 16 more Coal [[Coal]].","questIronSeamIronBarsHandInName":"Bring 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] to Spencer","questSpencerIronSeamIronBarsHandInDescription":"Bring the 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerIronSeamIronBarsReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] to go! Cragrock Mines has Pure Iron Ore [[Pure Iron Ore]] to spare.","questIronSeamCoalGatherName":"Gather 16 Coal [[Coal]]","questSpencerIronSeamCoalGatherDescription":"Mine the Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow until you have 16 Coal [[Coal]]. Coal [[Coal]] from the mines will do just as well!","questIronSeamCoalHandInName":"Bring 16 Coal [[Coal]] to Spencer","questSpencerIronSeamCoalHandInDescription":"Bring the 16 Coal [[Coal]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerIronSeamCoalReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]] to go! Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] keep growing it, and Cragrock Mines has plenty too.","questIronSeamUpgradeName":"Have Spencer Seed Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]","questSpencerIronSeamUpgradeDescription":"Come and see me on your island, and I\'ll seed your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with the Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]].","questSpencerIronSeamUpgraded":"In go the Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]], a good shake... there! Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] takes its time to show, so keep mining those generators, neighbour.","questIronSeamMineName":"Mine 4 Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] Grown by Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]]","questSpencerIronSeamMineDescription":"Stay on your island and mine 4 Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] as your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow it. Iron is twice as rare as coal, about one block in ten, so keep at it! Lost your generators? I\'ve got another for you.","questGoldSeamName":"A Glint of Gold","questSpencerGoldSeamDescription":"First coal, then iron... now picture your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] glinting with gold! Bring me 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] and 32 Coal [[Coal]], and I\'ll stir a little gold into the stone.","questSpencerGoldSeamWaitingOn":"I\'m dreaming of gold in your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]], neighbour, but the best gold is in the Gilded Gallery, past Elder Crag\'s mine door in Cragrock Mines. Prove yourself to him and he\'ll let you through!","questSpencerGoldSeamCompleted":"Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow coal, iron and now gold! Not one island I\'ve painted has generators as fine as these, neighbour.","questGoldSeamGoldBarsGatherName":"Smelt 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]","questSpencerGoldSeamGoldBarsGatherDescription":"Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines, and smelt the Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] into 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] with 12 more Coal [[Coal]].","questGoldSeamGoldBarsHandInName":"Bring 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to Spencer","questSpencerGoldSeamGoldBarsHandInDescription":"Bring the 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerGoldSeamGoldBarsReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to go! Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines.","questGoldSeamCoalGatherName":"Gather 32 Coal [[Coal]]","questSpencerGoldSeamCoalGatherDescription":"Mine the Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow until you have 32 Coal [[Coal]]. Coal [[Coal]] from the mines will do just as well!","questGoldSeamCoalHandInName":"Bring 32 Coal [[Coal]] to Spencer","questSpencerGoldSeamCoalHandInDescription":"Bring the 32 Coal [[Coal]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerGoldSeamCoalReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]] to go! Mine it at home or in Cragrock Mines, whichever\'s handier.","questGoldSeamUpgradeName":"Have Spencer Seed Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]","questSpencerGoldSeamUpgradeDescription":"Come and see me on your island, and I\'ll seed your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with the Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]].","questSpencerGoldSeamUpgraded":"A pinch of gold in each... and they\'re glinting already! Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] is shy, so mine away and catch it when it peeks out.","questGoldSeamMineName":"Mine 2 Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] Grown by Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]]","questSpencerGoldSeamMineDescription":"Stay on your island and mine 2 Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] as your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow it. Gold is the rarest yet, about one block in twenty, so watch for the glint! Lost your generators? I\'ve got another for you.","questSmudgeCoalSeamMeeting":"Spencer\'s idea, is it? Rock grows coal by sitting still a few thousand years. He hasn\'t got that long. Seed his stone with 32 Coal [[Coal]] from my quarry instead.","questSpencerStoneSpringWaitingOn":"I\'ve got a plan for a spring of stone, neighbour, but you\'ll need to learn mining first. Help Ruby at Ruby\'s Rockpile in the Hub!","questSpencerCarrotPatchWaitingOn":"I\'m dreaming of a carrot patch, neighbour, but Carrot Seeds [[Carrot Seeds]] only come from Manor Farm. Help Tillie in the Hub, and she\'ll show you the way there!","questSpencerFishPondWaitingOn":"I\'d love a pond with fish in it, neighbour! Learn to fish with Blubberbeard at Blubberbeard\'s Shack in the Hub first.","questSpencerPaintBoxDescription":"Neighbour, I\'ve painted this island so often that my paint box is empty! I mix my own paints, so let\'s start with yellow and red. The pear trees and the Watermelon [[Watermelon]] at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm have just the colours I need.","questSpencerPaintBoxCompleted":"Red and yellow, back in my paint box! Here\'s some Red Concrete [[Red Concrete]] and Yellow Concrete [[Yellow Concrete]] to build something bright, and Watermelon Seeds [[Watermelon Seeds]] so you can grow your own red.","questSpencerPaintBoxPearGatherDescription":"Break the Pear Blocks [[Pear Block]] off the low branches of the pear tree at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm until you have 3. They grow back quickly!","questSpencerPaintBoxPearHandInDescription":"Bring the 3 Pear Blocks [[Pear Block]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerPaintBoxPearHandedIn":"The perfect pear yellow! It\'s like sunshine in a paint pot.","questSpencerPaintBoxPearReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Pear Blocks [[Pear Block]] to go! They grow back on the low branches of the pear tree at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm.","questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonGatherDescription":"Harvest Watermelon [[Watermelon]] at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm until you have 32 Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]]. They\'ll make a lovely red!","questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonHandInDescription":"Bring the 32 Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonHandedIn":"What a juicy red! Just right for my sunsets.","questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]] to go! Harvest Watermelon [[Watermelon]] at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm.","questSpencerDeepPurpleDescription":"Neighbour, I\'m painting a royal portrait, and royals wear purple and gold! Nothing beats Beetroot [[Beetroot]] juice for a deep purple, and Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] make the finest gold leaf for the frame. Both start out in Cragrock Mines.","questSpencerDeepPurpleWaitingOn":"I\'m dreaming of a royal purple, neighbour, but Beetroot [[Beetroot]] only grows in Hearthdeep Village. Prove yourself to Elder Crag at his mine door in Cragrock Mines and he\'ll let you through. Ruby at Ruby\'s Rockpile in the Hub can show you the way there!","questSpencerDeepPurpleCompleted":"Purple and gold, fit for a king! Here\'s some Patterned Purple Glass [[Patterned Purple Glass]] for your windows, and Purple Torches [[Purple Torch]] to light them up at night.","questSpencerDeepPurpleBeetrootGatherDescription":"Pick 16 Beetroot [[Beetroot]] from the beetroot bed behind Sapphire\'s house in Hearthdeep Village, in Cragrock Mines.","questSpencerDeepPurpleBeetrootHandInDescription":"Bring the 16 Beetroot [[Beetroot]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerDeepPurpleBeetrootHandedIn":"Ooh, look at that colour! My fingers are purple already.","questSpencerDeepPurpleBeetrootReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Beetroot [[Beetroot]] to go! Sapphire\'s bed in Hearthdeep Village has plenty.","questSpencerDeepPurpleRawGoldGatherDescription":"Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines until you have 4 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]].","questSpencerDeepPurpleGoldCraftDescription":"Craft your Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] into 8 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]].","questSpencerDeepPurpleGoldHandInDescription":"Bring the 8 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] to me on your island.","questSpencerDeepPurpleGoldHandedIn":"Gold leaf! My frame is going to look so grand.","questSpencerDeepPurpleGoldReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] to go! Craft them from Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]].","questSpencerBoneWhiteDescription":"Every painting starts on a canvas, neighbour, and the best canvases are primed with bone white! The skeletons on the Scorched Flats in the Wild Infernos have the whitest Bones [[Bone]] around, and a Golem Eye [[Golem Eye]] ground up fine gives the white a pearly shine.","questSpencerBoneWhiteWaitingOn":"I need bone white for my canvases, neighbour, and the best Bones [[Bone]] are in the Wild Infernos. Lorenzo at the Badlands in the Hub can show you the way there!","questSpencerBoneWhiteCompleted":"A proper bone white with a pearly shine! My paint box is looking wonderful, neighbour, thanks to you. Plant these Cherry Saplings [[Cherry Sapling]] on your island, and just wait till you see the blossom!","questSpencerBoneWhiteBonesGatherDescription":"Defeat the skeletons on the Scorched Flats, just outside the gate of Emberwatch Outpost in the Wild Infernos, until you have 20 Bones [[Bone]].","questSpencerBoneWhiteBonesHandInDescription":"Bring the 20 Bones [[Bone]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerBoneWhiteBonesHandedIn":"Now that\'s a proper bone white, the perfect start for any painting!","questSpencerBoneWhiteBonesReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Bones [[Bone]] to go! The skeletons on the Scorched Flats in the Wild Infernos have plenty.","questSpencerBoneWhiteGolemEyesGatherDescription":"Knock the Magma Golems off the skeleton\'s ribs at the Shooting Gallery in the Wild Infernos until you have 4 Golem Eyes [[Golem Eye]]. Flint in her booth there can show you how!","questSpencerBoneWhiteGolemEyesHandInDescription":"Bring the 4 Golem Eyes [[Golem Eye]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerBoneWhiteGolemEyesHandedIn":"Look at that shine! Ground up fine, these will make my whites sparkle.","questSpencerBoneWhiteGolemEyesReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Golem Eyes [[Golem Eye]] to go! Go ask him about a sparring partner for your island!","questFindLorenzoDescription":"Find Lorenzo in the Hub and ask him about a sparring partner.","questSparringPartnerName":"Bring Lorenzo 4 Rotten Brains","questSparringPartnerDescription":"A duellist needs a worthy target! Then the Combat Dummy is yours!","questSparringPartnerCompleted":"Splendid! Take this Combat Dummy. Craft 12 Maple Wood Planks [[Maple Wood Planks]] from your logs first, then bridge the gap to me.","maverickNeedLogsForBridge":"Whoa, not so fast! Swap it for an Iron Chestplate [[Iron Chestplate]].","miniWantsWoodGauntlets":"Head and chest are sorted. Your hands aren\'t. Wear this chestplate \u2014 it has kept three heads safe for years, and it will keep you standing longer.","questNightWatchUnavailableHint":"Not now. Come back after dark, when the work is real. My patrol coat has spare lining, and I keep the trimmings. Bring me 12 Carrots [[Carrot]] for the three of us and it\'s yours.","questFurRunDelivery":"Bring Watch Dog 12 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]]","questFurRunErrandDescription":"Pull 12 Carrots [[Carrot]] at Tillie\'s Patch, the farm in the hub. Bring them to me at the dungeon portal and the fur is yours.","questFurRunReminder":"Not yet. {{remaining}} more Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]], then we trade.","questFurRunCompleted":"Fair trade. Take the fur to Tillie, and stay warm out there.","questAncientWoodlandName":"The Ancient Woodland","questAncientWoodlandDescription":"Some of these maples still hold ancient wood. Let the grove settle.","questAncientWoodlandNudge":"Timbertooth has work in the grove. Go and see him.","questAncientWoodlandErrandDescription":"Chop sparkling logs in Timbertooth Woods, behind me. Only you can see the sparkles. None near you? Try other trees.","questAncientWoodlandReminder":"{{remaining}} more Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]]. Look low on the trunks for sparkles.","questAncientWoodlandCompleted":"Good. Old wood, well cut. These leggings are made from it. Light on the feet.","questAncientWoodlandDelivery":"Bring Timbertooth 16 Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]]","questAllGearedUpName":"All Geared Up","questAllGearedUpDescription":"Mini has strong opinions about armour. Put on a full set and let him look you over.","questAllGearedUpInspection":"Wear 5 armour pieces that pass Mini\'s inspection","questAllGearedUpErrand":"Dress for the duel! Wear a helmet, chestplate, gauntlets, leggings and boots, then show Mini. ","questAllGearedUpUnavailableHint":"A moment, my friend \u2014 Mini is still polishing his horns. Return shortly.","questAllGearedUpNudge":"Lorenzo says Mini is ready to inspect your armour, over at The Badlands.","questHardenedEvidenceName":"A Hardened Hunch","questHardenedEvidenceDescription":"I\'ve had troubling reports from the far end of The Badlands. Travellers say the Zombies there have skin like rock and fists that pound the ground hard enough to throw a person off their feet. Worse, they\'ve made a camp. Zombies wander; they don\'t settle. A wise hunter learns his quarry before he draws his blade. Bring me proof, duellist!","questHardenedEvidenceErrand":"Find the Hardened Zombies camped at the far end of The Badlands and take 3 Hardened Hearts from them. Step out of the ring when they pound the ground!","questHardenedEvidenceCollect":"Defeat Hardened Zombies for 3 Hardened Hearts","questHardenedEvidenceDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 3 Hardened Hearts","questHardenedEvidenceHandInDescription":"Bring those Hardened Hearts back to me, duellist. I must see them with my own eyes!","questHardenedEvidenceReminder":"{{remaining}} more of those Hardened Hearts, duellist. If the travellers are right, I\'d rather know sooner than later.","questHardenedEvidenceCompleted":"Hard as rock, and still beating... The travellers were right. No ordinary Zombie grows a heart like this. Something out there is changing them, and I mean to find out what. Mini won\'t believe a word of it. You\'ve done the Hub a real service, duellist.","questHardenedResearchName":"Know Your Quarry","questHardenedResearchDescription":"Those Hardened Hearts have kept me up all night, duellist. Skin like rock, fists like hammers... Whatever hardens those Zombies, I mean to understand it, and perhaps to borrow it. That calls for research! Bring me samples from the Hardened Zombies, and from ordinary Zombies to compare. Do this, and I\'ll forge you something special.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentCollect":"Defeat Hardened Zombies for 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentGather":"Defeat Hardened Zombies at the far end of The Badlands for 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]. They flake off that rock-hard skin, and no other Zombie carries them.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentDeliver":"Bring the 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]] back to me for study.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentReminder":"I still need {{remaining}} more Iron Fragment [[Iron Fragment]]. Only the Hardened Zombies drop them, duellist.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentCompleted":"Iron, flaked straight off their skin! But iron alone doesn\'t walk about. Something more is at work here.","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainCollect":"Collect 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainGather":"Defeat Zombies in The Badlands for 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]. Any Zombie will do, though Hardened Zombies drop them more often.","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainDeliver":"Bring the 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]] back to me. Whatever you do, don\'t eat them!","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainReminder":"I still need {{remaining}} more Rotten Brain [[Rotten Brain]]. Any Zombie will do.","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainCompleted":"Brains! Let\'s see what they\'ve been thinking.","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshCollect":"Collect 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshGather":"Defeat Zombies in The Badlands for 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]], hardened or not. I need plenty to compare.","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshDeliver":"Bring the 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]] back to me. Hold your nose!","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshReminder":"I still need {{remaining}} more Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]], duellist. Hardened or not, any Zombie will do.","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshCompleted":"Every sample accounted for! Between these and those Hardened Hearts, I\'ve learned the magic that hardens them, and worked it into good iron. Behold, the Hardened Sword! Bring 4 of them back to me at Ruby\'s Rockpile, by the mines.","questCompressionFirstReminder":"{{remaining}} more Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]] and we\'re away. The rock is losing, friend!","questCompressionFirstDelivery":"Bring Ruby 4 Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]]","questCompressionFirstTurnIn":"Ha, heavier than it looks! Now squash those together: 2 Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]], please.","questCompressionSecondDescription":"Nine Compressed make one Extra Compressed at your island Workbench [[Workbench]]. Carry 2 down to me at Ruby\'s Rockpile, and mind your back.","questCompressionSecondReminder":"Another {{remaining}} Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]] to go. Stubborn rock? Be more stubborn!","questCompressionSecondDelivery":"Bring Ruby 2 Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]]","questCompressionSecondTurnIn":"Grand! One more squeeze, then. A single Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]] is all I ask.","questCompressionThirdDescription":"Nine Extra Compressed make one Super Compressed at your island Workbench [[Workbench]]. Just the one, brought down to me at Ruby\'s Rockpile, and I\'ll be happy.","questCompressionThirdReminder":"Still {{remaining}} Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]] short. The stone isn\'t going anywhere.","questCompressionThirdDelivery":"Bring Ruby 1 Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]]","questCompressionCompleted":"Would you look at that! Take this fool\'s gold pickaxe \u2014 worth nothing, smashes stone like nothing else, and now and then it digs up a better ore than the one you hit.","questCompressionUnavailableHint":"Give me a moment to clear my workbench, friend. Come back shortly.","questCompressionAvailableNudge":"Ruby has a daft idea about squashing stone. Go and see her at Ruby\'s Rockpile, by the mines.","questFlashFreezeName":"Flash Freeze","questFlashFreezeDescription":"A cold snap is coming, dear, and my old bones feel it. I\'ll have something for you shortly.","questFlashFreezeNudge":"Tillie has something for you, dear. Come and see her when you have a moment.","questFlashFreezeFur":"Bring Tillie 3 Fur [[Fur]]","questFlashFreezeFurDescription":"Watch Dog keeps spare fur, dear, and he stands guard at the dungeon portal in the hub. Give it a moment to regrow.","goofyGolemName":"Goofy Golem","golemFarmerIdle":"Mind how you go round the herd. They spook easy, but there\'s not a mean bone in them.","golemFarmerNotYet":"Easy now, the herd doesn\'t know you yet. Has Elder Crag sent you down? Go and see him at the mine door first.","golemFarmerQuestGreeting":"There you are! How\'s the herd treating you?","golemFarmerInventoryFull":"Your bags are full. Make some room and I\'ll hand you the gear.","golemFarmerTraded":"Moonstone Explosives [[Moonstone Explosive]] and Mining Grenades [[Mining Grenade]], fresh off the shelf. Set an explosive down by the herd, and throw a grenade at any ore you want out of the rock. Stand well back!","golemFarmerNeedsMoonstone":"Bring me 3 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] and I\'ll swap you 2 Moonstone Explosives [[Moonstone Explosive]] and 2 Mining Grenades [[Mining Grenade]]. Moonstone Ore [[Moonstone Ore]] grows in the cavern across the broken bridge. Once Grubnik\'s had his fee, his cannons will fire you over, and an Iron Pickaxe [[Iron Pickaxe]] digs it out.","golemFarmerTradePrompt":"Trade 3 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] for 2 Moonstone Explosives [[Moonstone Explosive]] + 2 Mining Grenades [[Mining Grenade]], up to 10 times","golemFarmerTradeFull":"Make room for your Moonstone Explosives [[Moonstone Explosive]] and Mining Grenades [[Mining Grenade]] before we trade.","golemFarmerShearingOffer":"Meet my Goofy Golems! Their skin grows diamond, and they shed it like old scales. Take these Moonstone Explosives [[Moonstone Explosive]]: set one down by the herd, stand well back, and the blast shakes the loose diamond off without a scratch. Shear me 3 Diamonds [[Diamond]] worth and you can keep every one.","golemFarmerShearingStepName":"Shear 3 Diamonds [[Diamond]] from the Goofy Golems","golemFarmerShearingStep":"Shear the herd in Glimmerdeep Hollow: set a Moonstone Explosive [[Moonstone Explosive]] down beside them and stand well back, throw a Mining Grenade [[Mining Grenade]] at them, or swing a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]]. Every 9 flakes make 1 Diamond [[Diamond]]. Run out of explosives? I\'ll trade you 2 for every 3 Moonstone [[Moonstone]].","golemFarmerShearingReminder":"The herd\'s still carrying plenty. Shear {{remaining}} more Diamond [[Diamond]] off them. Short on explosives? 3 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] buys 2.","golemFarmerShearingReportName":"Return to Shale","golemFarmerShearingReport":"That\'s 3 Diamonds [[Diamond]]! Come back to the cave door and tell me how the herd took it.","golemFarmerShearingCompleted":"Not a scratch on them, and look, the shine\'s coming back already. You\'re a born golem shearer! Keep those Diamonds [[Diamond]], and take a couple of explosives for next season.","questGolemShearingName":"Shearing Season","golemFarmerPickaxeOffer":"Explosives are all very well, but a proper rancher shears by hand. A Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]] lifts the diamond off one clean flake at a time, and the herd hardly feels it. Get yourself one and I\'ll teach you the knack.","golemFarmerPickaxeCraftName":"Craft a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]]","golemFarmerPickaxeCraft":"Craft a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]]. Moonstone [[Moonstone]] grows in the cavern across the broken bridge, where Grubnik\'s cannons can fire you.","golemFarmerPickaxeShearsName":"Shear the Goofy Golems 15 times with a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]]","golemFarmerPickaxeShears":"Now for the fun part! A golem gone all stone has nothing left to give, so move on to the next.","golemFarmerPickaxeReminder":"Gentle taps, mind! Come back to the cave door and tell me how the herd took it.","golemFarmerPickaxeCompleted":"Fifteen shears and not one scratch. You\'ve got a rancher\'s hands! Take these Mining Grenades [[Mining Grenade]] for the rock face, and come shear the herd whenever their shine grows back.","questGolemPickaxeName":"Shearing by Hand","miningForemanIdle":"Hearthdeep\'s still standing, more or less. Go and see him at the mine door.","miningForemanNeighbours":"Bram, Gilda and Sapphire still need a hand, friend. Look in on them at their houses, and come back to me once all three are sorted.","miningForemanQuestGreeting":"Good, you\'re back. How are my neighbours getting on?","miningForemanInventoryFull":"Your bags are full. Make some room and I\'ll settle up.","questMiningVillageAftermathName":"Hearthdeep in Ruins","miningForemanAftermath":"That big meteor shook our cavern to bits, and half of Hearthdeep came down with it. Mending walls is my job, but three of my neighbours need help I can\'t give them. Will you go and see Bram, Gilda and Sapphire?","miningForemanMeetFatherName":"Talk to Bram in his house","miningForemanMeetFather":"Bram\'s house is the pink one past the golden pickaxe statue. He\'s in a terrible state, so go and hear him out.","miningForemanMeetFundraiserName":"Talk to Gilda in her house","miningForemanMeetFundraiser":"Gilda is raising gold for the rebuild from her house by the cavern wall. Go and see what she needs.","miningForemanMeetBeetFarmerName":"Talk to Sapphire at her beetroot bed","miningForemanMeetBeetFarmer":"Sapphire grows her beetroot out back, past her house. She\'s Ruby\'s mother, and just as tough. She\'s got work for a strong pair of arms.","questMiningVillageRebuiltName":"Hearthdeep Stands","miningForemanRebuilt":"Bram has his Pip back, Gilda\'s gold is in and Sapphire\'s stacking stone. Come and find me by the statue, would you?","miningForemanRebuiltReportName":"Return to Dorrik","miningForemanRebuiltReport":"Meet Dorrik by the golden pickaxe statue and tell him how the village is doing.","miningForemanRebuiltCompleted":"Look at this place! Clear some space first.","questMiningLostDaughterName":"Lost in the Rubble","miningFatherLostDaughter":"My little Pip ran off when the meteor hit, and she hasn\'t come home. It\'s not much, but please take this.","miningDaughterHiding":"Shh! I\'m hiding. The shyest bite yet, so be patient, matey.","questBowlineReportDescription":"Got all five? Come back and see old Blubberbeard.","questBowlineCompleted":"Five more fish, and a fine Bowline tied. Thank you, matey. Take this Bowline Rod. Fish bite on it sooner, and it brings up two at once more often.","questBowlineDarter":"Catch or bring a Darter [[Darter]]","questBowlineRootFlounder":"Catch or bring a Root Flounder [[Root Flounder]]","questBowlineGreenfinLoach":"Catch or bring a Greenfin Loach [[Greenfin Loach]]","questBowlineGreenStrongfish":"Catch or bring a Green Strongfish [[Green Strongfish]]","questBowlineSeahorse":"Catch or bring a Seahorse [[Seahorse]]","questAnchorBendName":"The Anchor Bend","questAnchorBendDescription":"Now for some stronger fish, matey, and shyer ones too, so settle in for a longer wait: a Spined Stickleback [[Spined Stickleback]], a Moon Strongfish [[Moon Strongfish]], a Boulder Bass [[Boulder Bass]] and a Grass Snapper [[Grass Snapper]]. Cast in any water here in the hub.","questAnchorBendSpinedSticklebackDescription":"Catch or bring a Spined Stickleback [[Spined Stickleback]]. Prickly little thing, so hold on tight.","questAnchorBendMoonStrongfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Moon Strongfish [[Moon Strongfish]]. Pale as the moon, and strong as its cousins.","questAnchorBendBoulderBassDescription":"Catch or bring a Boulder Bass [[Boulder Bass]]. Heavy as a rock, so pull with all you have.","questAnchorBendGrassSnapperDescription":"Catch or bring a Grass Snapper [[Grass Snapper]]. It snaps quickly, so be ready.","questAnchorBendReportDescription":"Got all four? Come back and see old Blubberbeard.","questAnchorBendCompleted":"Four strong fish, and the Anchor Bend tied. Thank you, matey. Take this Anchor Rod. Fish bite on it a touch sooner, and rare fish bite on it far more often.","questAnchorBendSpinedStickleback":"Catch or bring a Spined Stickleback [[Spined Stickleback]]","questAnchorBendMoonStrongfish":"Catch or bring a Moon Strongfish [[Moon Strongfish]]","questAnchorBendBoulderBass":"Catch or bring a Boulder Bass [[Boulder Bass]]","questAnchorBendGrassSnapper":"Catch or bring a Grass Snapper [[Grass Snapper]]","questFishermansKnotName":"The Fisherman\'s Knot","questFishermansKnotDescription":"In all my years I\'ve seen a Crystalized Wheatfish [[Crystalized Wheatfish]] and a Moonstone Pupfish [[Moonstone Pupfish]] only a handful of times. Catch me one of each, matey.","questFishermansKnotCrystalizedWheatfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Crystalized Wheatfish [[Crystalized Wheatfish]]. It can slip off the hook, so hold on tight.","questFishermansKnotMoonstonePupfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Moonstone Pupfish [[Moonstone Pupfish]], the rarest fish in these waters. Be quick when it bites.","questFishermansKnotReportDescription":"Got them both? Come back and see old Blubberbeard.","questFishermansKnotCompleted":"Both of them! Few anglers ever see those, matey. Thank you. Take this Fisherman\'s Rod. Fish bite on it quicker than on any rod I\'ve given you, one catch in four brings up a second fish, and rare fish bite on it just as often as on your Anchor Rod.","questFishermansKnotCrystalizedWheatfish":"Catch or bring a Crystalized Wheatfish [[Crystalized Wheatfish]]","questFishermansKnotMoonstonePupfish":"Catch or bring a Moonstone Pupfish [[Moonstone Pupfish]]","woodyQuestGreeting":"You\'re back. Come and talk when you\'re ready.","catnissQuestGreeting":"Ah, my favourite challenger returns! Come, let us talk.","digoryQuestGreeting":"There you are, friend! Come and have a word.","gillQuestGreeting":"Hello again, dear. Come and have a chat when you\'re ready.","blubberbeardQuestGreeting":"Ahoy, matey! Come and have a word with old Blubberbeard.","grimbaldQuestGreeting":"You. Human. Over here.","grimbaldInventoryFull":"Your pack\'s full. Make room, then talk to me.","questTroubleBelowName":"Trouble Below","questTroubleBelowDescription":"Meteors fall on Cragrock Mines all the time, but a big one has just struck. My mum Sapphire lives there, and they need every pair of hands. The old portal at the back of my Rockpile has a Portal Guardian charging {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head. Go and see Up Dog at the hub\'s Market first; he\'ll help you sell your way there.","questTroubleBelowLearnedDescription":"Meteors fall on Cragrock Mines all the time, but a big one has just struck. My mum Sapphire lives there, and they need every pair of hands. The old portal at the back of my Rockpile has a Portal Guardian charging {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head. I can smell Up Dog on you from here, so you know the Market. Sell what you can spare and pay him!","questTroubleBelowFreeDescription":"Meteors fall on Cragrock Mines all the time, but a big one has just struck. My mum Sapphire lives there, and they need every pair of hands. The Portal Guardian at the back of my Rockpile will let you through the old portal. Go on, they\'re waiting!","questTroubleBelowMarket":"Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub","questTroubleBelowMarketDescription":"Visit Up Dog at the hub\'s Market. He\'ll show you how to sell spare ore for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.","questTroubleBelowMarketLearned":"You smell like Up Dog, friend, so you\'ve found the Market already. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].","questTroubleBelowPortal":"Use the cyan portal to Cragrock Mines","questTroubleBelowPortalDescription":"Toll paid! Step through the cyan portal at the back of my Rockpile to reach Cragrock Mines.","questTroubleBelowFreePortalDescription":"Step through the cyan portal at the back of my Rockpile to reach Cragrock Mines.","questTroubleBelowGrimbald":"Speak to Elder Crag at the mine entrance","questTroubleBelowGrimbaldDescription":"Find Elder Crag by the mine entrance and tell him I sent you. Don\'t take his grumbling to heart!","questTroubleBelowMeeting":"Ruby sent me a human? Hmph. I asked for help, not sightseers. That big meteor took half our tunnels and most of our nerve, so you\'ll have to do.","questIntoTheInfernosName":"Into the Wild Infernos","questIntoTheInfernosDescription":"You\'ve earned this, duellist. Past the old frame at the far end of The Badlands lie the Wild Infernos, the desert where Mini and I grew up. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, so see Up Dog at the hub\'s Market first. He\'ll help you sell your way there.","questIntoTheInfernosLearnedDescription":"You\'ve earned this, duellist. Past the old frame at the far end of The Badlands lie the Wild Infernos, the desert where Mini and I grew up. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, and you know the Market already. Sell your spoils and pay him!","questIntoTheInfernosFreeDescription":"You\'ve earned this, duellist. Past the old frame at the far end of The Badlands lie the Wild Infernos, the desert where Mini and I grew up. Its Portal Guardian will let you through. Go on, the desert awaits!","questIntoTheInfernosMarket":"Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub","questIntoTheInfernosMarketDescription":"Visit Up Dog at the hub\'s Market. He\'ll show you how to sell your spoils for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.","questIntoTheInfernosMarketLearned":"You\'ve met Up Dog already, so you know the Market. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].","questIntoTheInfernosPortal":"Use the red portal to the Wild Infernos","questIntoTheInfernosPortalDescription":"Toll paid! Step through the red portal at the far end of The Badlands to reach the Wild Infernos.","questIntoTheInfernosFreePortalDescription":"Step through the red portal at the far end of The Badlands to reach the Wild Infernos.","questIntoTheInfernosAshhorn":"Speak to Elder Ashborn in the outpost","questIntoTheInfernosAshhornDescription":"Find Elder Ashborn in Emberwatch Outpost, beside the portal, and tell him I sent you. He taught Mini and me everything we know, so mind your manners!","questIntoTheInfernosMeeting":"Lorenzo\'s student? Then you are welcome here, traveller. Humans and minotaurs share this outpost, the only safe ground for miles. The desert beyond our walls is cruel, but its fire is sacred. Walk it with respect.","questIntoTheReachName":"Into the Lantern Reach","questIntoTheReachDescription":"You\'ve a real angler\'s hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I\'ve never been back. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, so see Up Dog at the hub\'s Market first. He\'ll help you sell your way there.","questIntoTheReachLearnedDescription":"You\'ve a real angler\'s hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I\'ve never been back. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, and you know the Market already. Sell what you can spare and pay him!","questIntoTheReachFreeDescription":"You\'ve a real angler\'s hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I\'ve never been back. The Portal Guardian will let you through. Go and see it for me.","questIntoTheReachMarket":"Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub","questIntoTheReachMarketDescription":"Visit Up Dog at the hub\'s Market. He\'ll show you how to sell spare resources for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.","questIntoTheReachMarketLearned":"You\'ve met Up Dog already, so you know the Market. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].","questIntoTheReachPortal":"Use the blue portal to the Lantern Reach","questIntoTheReachPortalDescription":"Toll paid! Step through the blue portal at the west end of my path to reach the Lantern Reach.","questIntoTheReachFreePortalDescription":"Step through the blue portal at the west end of my path to reach the Lantern Reach.","questIntoTheReachKeeper":"Speak to Stinky at the lighthouse","questIntoTheReachKeeperDescription":"Follow the jetty from the harbour to the lighthouse on its rock. You\'ll smell old Stinky before you see him! Tell him Blubberbeard sent you, and that I\'m sorry.","questIntoTheReachMeeting":"Blubberbeard sent you? My old apprentice... Tell him there\'s nothing to forgive. Welcome to the Lantern Reach, friend. Everyone here calls me Stinky, and you\'ll soon smell why! The Lamp has been dark a long while, and the fish sleep deep without its light. But a good angler might just wake them.","keeperWickNothingToDo":"Sit a while and watch the water, friend. Upwind of me, if you like. Every ripple has a story.","keeperWickQuestGreeting":"Ah, a visitor! Come into the light, such as it is. Don\'t mind the flies, they\'re old friends.","keeperWickInventoryFull":"Your pack is full to the brim, friend. Make some room and come back.","lanternReachHush":"This water is still. Only small fry bite here until Stinky\'s lens shines on it.","questKeeperWickLensHandIn":"Ah, look at it glow! Thank you, friend.","questKeeperWickLensReport":"Report back to Stinky","questKelpwoodLensName":"The Kelpwood Lens","questKelpwoodLensDescription":"The lagoon fish still carry a little of the old light. Catch me a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]], a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]], an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]] and a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]] here in the lagoon, and their glow will relight the lens that faces Kelpwood.","questKelpwoodLensReportDescription":"Got all four? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.","questNothingToForgiveName":"Nothing to Forgive","questNothingToForgiveDescription":"The Lamp is waking at last, and its light reaches further every day. Would you carry a message for an old Keeper, friend? My apprentice never heard my answer. Tell Blubberbeard there\'s nothing to forgive, and that the Lamp burns again.","questNothingToForgiveTell":"Tell Blubberbeard in the Hub","questNothingToForgiveTellDescription":"Find Blubberbeard by his shack in the Hub and give him Stinky\'s answer.","questNothingToForgiveCompleted":"He said that? Nothing to forgive... I\'ve carried that guilt since I was a lad, matey. And the Lamp burns again! Here, take these two Glowtide Flares I\'ve kept since I left. Light one over Reach water and think of an old Keeper.","questKelpwoodLensCompleted":"Look, friend! The west lens is burning again, and its beam has reached Kelpwood. The fish there are waking already. Take my old Tidelight Rod. Its line still holds a little of the Lamp\'s light, so fish bite on it quicker and two at a time more often.","questAmethystLensName":"The Amethyst Lens","questAmethystLensDescription":"Kelpwood is waking, and its big fish glow brighter than anything in the lagoon. Catch me a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]], a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]], a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]], a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]] and an Oarfish [[Oarfish]] in Kelpwood\'s water, west across the bridge, and we\'ll light the lens that faces the Amethyst shoals.","questAmethystLensReportDescription":"Got all five? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.","questAmethystLensCompleted":"Two lenses lit! The east beam has reached the Amethyst shoals, and the crystals are humming. This Glowglass Rod has a chip of the Kelpwood lens for a float, and fish come to it sooner.","questMoonwellLensName":"The Moonwell Lens","questMoonwellLensDescription":"Now the lens that faces the Moonwell, where the oldest fish sleep. It needs the brightest catches in the Reach. Catch me an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]], a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]], a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]], a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]] and a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]] in the Amethyst shoals, east across the bridge.","questMoonwellLensReportDescription":"Got all five? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.","questMoonwellLensCompleted":"Three beams across the water, friend! The Moonwell is stirring at last. Take the Moonwell Rod. It\'s cut from amethyst and cooled in that very pool, and the deepest fish rise to it.","questKelpwoodLensHatchetfish":"Catch or bring a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]]","questKelpwoodLensHatchetfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]]. A thin silver thing that glints when it turns. The lagoon is full of them.","questKelpwoodLensPolarflash":"Catch or bring a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]]","questKelpwoodLensPolarflashDescription":"Catch or bring a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]]. It still sparks a little in the lagoon\'s dark water. Quick on the hook!","questKelpwoodLensAetherMinnow":"Catch or bring an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]]","questKelpwoodLensAetherMinnowDescription":"Catch or bring an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]]. Pale as mist, and the gentlest bite in the lagoon.","questKelpwoodLensStoneGrouper":"Catch or bring a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]]","questKelpwoodLensStoneGrouperDescription":"Catch or bring a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]]. It hides on the lagoon floor and rarely bites, so be patient.","questAmethystLensArapaima":"Catch or bring a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]","questAmethystLensArapaimaDescription":"Catch or bring a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]. Big and slow, with a back as green as the kelp it hides in.","questAmethystLensStingray":"Catch or bring a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]]","questAmethystLensStingrayDescription":"Catch or bring a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]]. It glides low through the mangrove roots. Reel it in steadily.","questAmethystLensSawfish":"Catch or bring a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]]","questAmethystLensSawfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]]. Mind its nose! It fights hard all the way in from Kelpwood\'s channels.","questAmethystLensSturgeon":"Catch or bring a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]]","questAmethystLensOarfish":"Catch or bring an Oarfish [[Oarfish]]","questAmethystLensSturgeonDescription":"Catch or bring a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]]. The oldest fish in Kelpwood, and a shy one.","questAmethystLensOarfishDescription":"Catch or bring an Oarfish [[Oarfish]]. Long as a jetty and rarely seen. Keep casting in Kelpwood\'s water, and it will come.","questMoonwellLensEel":"Catch or bring an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]]","questMoonwellLensEelDescription":"Catch or bring an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]]. It crackles with light of its own down in the shoals. Just the thing for a lens!","questMoonwellLensDarter":"Catch or bring a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]]","questMoonwellLensDarterDescription":"Catch or bring a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]]. Quick as a shadow between the crystals. Watch your float closely.","questMoonwellLensMoray":"Catch or bring a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]]","questMoonwellLensMorayDescription":"Catch or bring a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]]. It hides in the crystal cracks and bites hard when it does.","questMoonwellLensDragonfish":"Catch or bring a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]]","questMoonwellLensGiantMoray":"Catch or bring a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]]","questMoonwellLensDragonfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]]. It shines like moonlight on the Amethyst shoals.","questMoonwellLensGiantMorayDescription":"Catch or bring a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]]. The biggest hunter in the shoals, and the rarest bite of all. Patience, friend.","questTheHushName":"The Hush","questTheHushDescription":"Three lenses lit, and still the Lamp won\'t wake fully. That\'s the Hush, friend. It\'s no curse, only a great old fish that fell asleep in the Moonwell when the light went out, and the whole Reach went quiet with it. Will you call it up for me? Gently, now. It only needs waking.","questTheHushCall":"Wait for the Hush in the Moonwell without reeling in","questTheHushCallDescription":"Cast into the Moonwell, north across the bridge from the Lamp, and keep still while you wait: a tap or click reels the line in. When the Hush rises, tap to bring it up and it will swim home.","questTheHushReturn":"Return to Stinky","questTheHushReturnDescription":"The Hush is home in the deep again. Go and tell Stinky at the lighthouse.","questTheHushCompleted":"There! Do you see it? The whole Lamp is shining, friend, brighter than I\'ve seen it since I was young. The Hush was never our enemy. It only needed someone patient enough to call it up and let it be. Take these five Glowtide Flares, and fish the Moonwell whenever you like. That old fish may come up to say hello.","questLanternReachMailName":"News of the Lantern Reach","questLanternReachMailDescription":"There you are! The portal to the Lantern Reach can finally be opened. Blubberbeard grew up out there, and he\'s been staring at that portal all week. Go and ask him about it!","questAskBlubberbeardAboutReach":"Ask Blubberbeard about the Lantern Reach","questAskBlubberbeardAboutReachDescription":"Find Blubberbeard by his shack in the Hub and take on his task to reach the Lantern Reach.","kelpwoodResidentQuestGreeting":"There you are, dear. I was hoping you\'d drift by.","kelpwoodResidentInventoryFull":"Your pockets are full, dear. Make a little room, and I\'ll give you what I owe you.","questLostPoolName":"The Lost Pool","questLostPoolDescription":"When I was young, dear, there was a pool hidden among these roots, where the kelp meets the cliff. The wisps still whisper of it. Would you find it and catch 3 fish there? I\'d so like to know it\'s still alive.","questLostPoolCatch":"Catch 3 fish in Kelpwood\'s hidden pool","questLostPoolCatchDescription":"Search Kelpwood\'s west rim, behind the trees on the far side from its bridge, for a crack of hidden water. Cast into it and land 3 fish.","questLostPoolReturn":"Return to Auntie Glenda","questLostPoolReturnDescription":"The old pool is still full of fish. Go and tell Auntie Glenda among Kelpwood\'s roots.","questLostPoolCompleted":"Still full of fish, after all these years... Thank you, dear. I feel a little lighter, as if the mist has thinned. Take these Glowtide Flares, and the [[Gold Coin]] that washed into my roots.","kelpwoodResidentLampFestivalInvited":"A festival at the Lamp? Oh, dear, I haven\'t been to one in a hundred years. I\'ll drift across the water as soon as the lanterns are lit.","amethystResidentQuestGreeting":"You came back! I\'ve got a really important job for you.","amethystResidentInventoryFull":"Your bag\'s too full! Make some room, then come back. I\'ve got something for you!","questPerfectPitchName":"Perfect Pitch","questPerfectPitchDescription":"When the Lamp\'s beam shines on my crystals, the fish swim up to listen! I want to hear them sing. Catch 3 fish where the beam touches the Amethyst water, and I\'ll tune to their song.","questPerfectPitchCatch":"Catch 3 fish where the Lamp\'s beam touches the Amethyst water","questPerfectPitchCatchDescription":"Find the column of light where the Lamp\'s beam touches the Amethyst water. It drifts across the water and rests now and then, so cast into it and keep your float in its light until the bite. Land 3 fish bitten there.","questPerfectPitchReturn":"Return to Urchin","questPerfectPitchReturnDescription":"The shoal sang in the beam\'s light. Go and tell Urchin by his dock hut.","questPerfectPitchCompleted":"Listen... every crystal is singing the same song! You did it! Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]]. And tell Stinky he still hums flat. Don\'t say it was me!","amethystResidentLampFestivalInvited":"A festival? With music?! I\'ll tune every crystal on the shoals. Can I stay up for the lanterns?","moonwellResidentQuestGreeting":"Softly... oh, it\'s you. Come and sit by the well.","moonwellResidentInventoryFull":"Your pack is full... make a little room, and I\'ll give you what I promised.","questGlowtideLullabyName":"Glowtide Lullaby","questGlowtideLullabyDescription":"When the glowtide drifts over the Moonwell, the sleeping fish rise to dream in its glow. Would you catch 40 of them there for me? Then I\'ll know what they\'re dreaming, and what to sing.","questGlowtideLullabyCatch":"Catch 40 fish in a glowtide bloom on the Moonwell","questGlowtideLullabyCatchDescription":"Find a glowing glowtide bloom on the Moonwell\'s water, cast into it and land 40 fish while your float is in its glow. A Glowtide Flare calls up a bloom of your own.","questGlowtideLullabyReturn":"Return to Hesper","questGlowtideLullabyReturnDescription":"The Moonwell\'s fish rose to the glow. Go and tell Hesper at the Moonwell.","questGlowtideLullabyCompleted":"They dream of the light... every one of them. I\'ll sing them something new tonight. Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]], and keep the Moonwell glowing.","moonwellResidentLampFestivalInvited":"A festival at the Lamp... I\'ll bring my lantern, and sing the fish to sleep after. Wake me if I doze off.","pimLampFestivalInvited":"A festival?! At the Lamp?! I\'ll hang the bunting! I\'ll bake! Oh, I\'ve waited my whole life for this!","questLampFestivalInvitedBlubberbeard":"A festival at the Lamp, and old Stinky asked for me? ...Tell him I\'ll be there, matey. It\'s high time I went home.","questLampFestivalName":"The Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalDescription":"The whole Lamp is shining, friend, and every island is awake again. Time we had a Lamp Festival, like the ones I knew as a boy! Will you invite everyone for me? Start with Auntie Glenda, over on Kelpwood.","questLampFestivalRose":"Invite Rose to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalRoseDescription":"Back to the harbour now. Find Rose by her Tide Ledger and invite her to the Lamp Festival. She\'ll want to bake.","questLampFestivalGlenda":"Invite Auntie Glenda to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalGlendaDescription":"Find Auntie Glenda among Kelpwood\'s roots, west across the bridge, and invite her to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalChime":"Invite Urchin to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalChimeDescription":"Find Urchin by his dock hut on the Amethyst shoals, east across the bridge, and invite him to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalHesper":"Invite Hesper to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalHesperDescription":"Find Hesper at the Moonwell, north across the bridge, and invite her to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalBlubberbeard":"Invite Blubberbeard to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalBlubberbeardDescription":"Everyone in the Reach is coming. Go back through the portal to the Hub, find Blubberbeard by his shack, and invite him home to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalReturn":"Return to Stinky","questLampFestivalReturnDescription":"Blubberbeard is coming home! Go and tell Stinky at the lighthouse.","questLampFestivalCompleted":"Blubberbeard\'s coming home? Oh, friend... I never stopped keeping a light on for him. Look at the Reach tonight: every island lit, and all of us together again. You did this. Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]], and come to every festival we ever have.","keeperWickHushWaitShh":"Shh... Keep still and let the line rest, friend.","keeperWickHushWaitStill":"Still now. Something old is stirring...","keeperWickHushWaitNearly":"Nearly... It\'s rising to you.","keeperWickHushWaitAbandoned":"Shh... it\'s still close. Cast again and keep still.","keeperWickHushReelLost":"Oh! It slipped back down, friend. Cast again, it\'s still close.","keeperWickHushWaitInterrupted":"The Hush is still close, friend. Cast again when you\'re ready.","keeperWickKeepersChairLocked":"Not yet, friend. The Keeper\'s Chair waits until the whole Lamp is awake.","keeperWickKeepersChairWelcome":"Sit a while, friend. Turn the Lamp toward any water you\'ve lit, and it will shine a little kinder there, just for you.","keepersChairTitle":"Keeper\'s Chair","keepersChairClose":"Close the Keeper\'s Chair","keepersChairPrompt":"Sit in the Keeper\'s Chair","keepersChairRopeUp":"Climb to the lantern room","keepersChairRopeDown":"Climb down","keepersChairKelpwood":"Kelpwood","keepersChairAmethyst":"Amethyst Shoals","keepersChairMoonwell":"Moonwell","keepersChairAim":"Aim the Lamp","keepersChairAimLabel":"Aim the Lamp at {{island}}","keepersChairAimed":"Lamp aimed","keepersChairRest":"Rest the Lamp","keepersChairDark":"Lens still dark","keepersChairTideNotice":"Today\'s Tide Notice","keepersChairFavour":"Aimed water: blooms hold more rares and last longer, and the Tide Notice fish bites more often.","keepersChairAimedStatus":"The Lamp shines on {{island}}.","keepersChairRestedStatus":"The Lamp rests, shining on every island alike.","keepersChairTooFar":"Climb to the lantern room to aim the Lamp.","keepersChairNotRelit":"Relight that island\'s lens first.","keeperWickReachLogWelcome":"My old logbook, friend. It smells of bait, like me! Land the biggest of each fish and I\'ll ink it in, bright as a beam.","keeperWickReachLogPageGold":"A whole page in gold! Not even the Lamp shines that bright. Take these three Glowtide Flares, friend.","keeperWickLampLightWelcome":"Every fish you let go leaves a little light behind, friend. The Lamp keeps it safe for you.","keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseKelpwood":"A Kelpwood fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight Kelpwood\'s lens and they\'ll swim home.","keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseAmethyst":"An Amethyst Shoals fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight their lens and they\'ll swim home.","keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseMoonwell":"A Moonwell fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight the Moonwell\'s lens and they\'ll swim home.","keeperWickHiddenWatersAllFound":"Every hidden water in the Reach! Even I\'d forgotten one or two. No ordinary armour survives that heat, but the old Magmaward does. The skeletons on the plains carry bones baked hard by the desert fire. Bring Elder Ashborn 40 Bones [[Bone]] and he will forge you its helmet.","questEldersBonesErrand":"Defeat the skeletons on the plains outside the outpost gate and gather 40 Bones [[Bone]] for Elder Ashborn at the outpost.","questEldersBonesCollect":"Gather 40 Bones [[Bone]] from the plains\' skeletons","questEldersBonesDelivery":"Bring Elder Ashborn 40 Bones [[Bone]]","questEldersBonesHandIn":"Bring the 40 Bones [[Bone]] to Elder Ashborn at the outpost. That\'s never good.","kadeQuestGreeting":"Climbing, or just looking?","kadeInventoryFull":"Your pack\'s full. Empty it before you climb.","grizzlefuseNothingToDo":"Hear that? That\'s the sound of nothing exploding. Tragic!","grizzlefuseQuestGreeting":"A visitor! Mind the powder, spotter!","grizzlefuseInventoryFull":"Your pack\'s stuffed, spotter! Now we fight!","questMagmawardDescription":"The rest of the Magmaward is out beyond the plains. Kade keeps watch at the Tower of Doom, Grizzlefuse holds the fort above the Scorp Pit, Flint runs the Shooting Gallery in the lava basin, and Mortimus keeps the Shuffling Crypt by the Ashen Fort. Each keeps a piece. Win any you are missing, then come back to me.","questMagmawardPlateDescription":"Cross the bridge east of the plains to the Tower of Doom. Kade waits at its door.","questMagmawardReportDescription":"You hold every piece the lands could give. Bring them back to Elder Ashborn at the outpost.","questMagmawardCompleted":"Every piece, earned. Wear all five and the armour burns Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]] to keep the lava off you, one flask at a time. Ward, Kade, Grizzlefuse, Flint and Mortimus each have a flask for you now. Then hear me out about that volcano.","questMagmawardName":"The Magmaward","questMagmawardPlate":"Win the Magmaward Chestplate at Kade\'s Tower of Doom","questMagmawardReport":"Return to Elder Ashborn","questTowerOfDoomDescription":"See that roof? The Doom Warlord took my tower, and it wears the Magmaward Chestplate. Every floor is held by its retinue: squires, brutes and curators, and their seals keep the way to the roof shut. Beat one of each on your way up.","questTowerOfDoomSquireDescription":"Cinder Squires hold the Tower of Doom\'s ground hall. When one lifts its burning hammer, step out of the ring before it comes down, and keep out of the fire it leaves.","questTowerOfDoomBruteDescription":"A Gauntlet Brute waits on the mezzanine above the Tower of Doom\'s hall. When it claps, jump the shockwave as it rolls across the floor.","questTowerOfDoomCuratorDescription":"Glass Curators keep the Tower of Doom\'s library, further up. If one shuts you in a glass case, hit the glass to break out.","questTowerOfDoomClimbDescription":"The seals are broken. Climb the rest of the stairs to Holt in the wizard room, beside the grey portal to the roof.","questTowerOfDoomRoofDescription":"Take the red portal beside Holt up to the roof and defeat the Doom Warlord.","questTowerOfDoomReportDescription":"The Warlord is down! Go back to Holt in the Tower of Doom\'s wizard room. The roof\'s portal takes you straight to him.","questTowerOfDoomCompleted":"Back in one piece, and with the Warlord\'s own Chestplate. Not many walk off that roof. The Warlord\'ll be back up there by tomorrow, mind. It always is.","questDailyTowerDescription":"The Doom Warlord\'s back on my roof. It always comes back. Climb up and knock it down again.","questDailyTowerClimbDescription":"Climb the Tower of Doom, or Holt\'s rope if it\'s yours, and take the red portal beside Holt up to the roof. Defeat the Doom Warlord.","questDailyTowerReportDescription":"Down it goes again! Take the roof\'s portal back down and tell Kade at the tower door.","questDailyTowerCompleted":"Good. That holds it for a day. Same again tomorrow?","questDailyTowerDone":"You\'ve done your climb for today. The Warlord\'s still licking its wounds.","questTowerOfDoomName":"The Tower of Doom","questTowerOfDoomClimb":"Defeat the Doom Warlord on the Tower of Doom\'s roof","questTowerOfDoomSquire":"Defeat a Cinder Squire","questTowerOfDoomBrute":"Defeat a Gauntlet Brute","questTowerOfDoomCurator":"Defeat a Glass Curator","questTowerOfDoomMeetHolt":"Climb the Tower of Doom to Holt in the wizard room","questTowerOfDoomReport":"Return to Kade at the Tower of Doom","questTowerOfDoomReportHolt":"Return to Holt in the wizard room","questDailyTowerName":"Back on the Roof","mobScorpion":"Scorpion","mobMummy":"Mummy","mobCinderSquire":"Cinder Squire","mobGauntletBrute":"Gauntlet Brute","mobGlassCurator":"Glass Curator","towerPortalSealed":"The portal is sealed! The seals are broken, so this portal behind me takes you to the roof. The Doom Warlord\'s waiting up there.","questHoltsRopeName":"Holt\'s Rope","questHoltsRopeDescription":"Those stairs are a long walk. I gave up on them, and nobody should have to do them twice. I\'ll pin a rope from up here to Kade\'s door, but rope needs rivets. The Warlord\'s guards on the stairs are full of Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]]. Bring me 20.","questHoltsRopeRivetsCollect":"Collect 20 Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]]","questHoltsRopeRivetsErrand":"Defeat the Warlord\'s guards on the Tower of Doom\'s stairs for Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]]. Now, my fee: one Doom Crest [[Doom Crest]]. The Warlord dropped you one, didn\'t it?","questHoltsRopeCrestCollect":"Get a Doom Crest [[Doom Crest]]","questHoltsRopeCrestErrand":"Get a Doom Crest [[Doom Crest]] for Holt. Fair\'s fair.","questHoltsRopeCompleted":"Pleasure doing business. The rope\'s hung beside Kade\'s door. Give it a tug and up you come, straight to me, no stairs.","questWordOfATraderName":"Word of a Trader","questWordOfATraderDescription":"Rope\'s yours, so here\'s something for nothing. Climbers talk of a trader out at the edge of the world who sells things you won\'t find anywhere else. Word is, one of this tower\'s windows lets out that way. Have a look on your way down.","questWordOfATraderWindow":"Find the window out of the Tower of Doom","questWordOfATraderWindowDescription":"One of the Tower of Doom\'s windows, a few floors up, has a way out. Look around for it.","questWordOfATraderSmuglyn":"Find Smuglyn, the trader at the edge of the world","questWordOfATraderSmuglynDescription":"The way out leads to the edge of the world. Find Smuglyn and see what he sells.","questWordOfATraderCompleted":"Ah, someone who knows the back way in. Here, 5 Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]] on the house, to start you off. My wares change every day. Do take a look.","mobCryptDread":"Crypt Dread","cryptShifting":"The crypt is shifting!","cryptEscaped":"You escaped the crypt in {{time}}!","mortarStrike":"Mortar Strike","mortarOutOfRange":"The mortar can\'t reach down here.","interdimensionalStrike":"Interdimensional Mortar Strike","interdimensionalStrikeBusy":"Your last rift\'s still open!","interdimensionalStrikeNotHere":"Rifts only open on your own island!","interdimensionalStrikeNoRoom":"No room for a rift here!","questMagmawardGauntletsDescription":"Cross the bridge east of the plains to the Scorp Pit. After the MAGMAWARD GAUNTLETS? They\'re mine to give! Earn \'em! The pit\'s crawling with scorpions. Take these Mortar Strikes [[Red Firecracker Pebble]]: chuck one in and my mortar does the rest. BOOM! Thin out 50 for me!","questScorpPitHuntDescription":"Throw a Mortar Strike [[Red Firecracker Pebble]] into the Scorp Pit to bring Grizzlefuse\'s mortar down on it, or fight with your own weapon. Defeat 50 scorpions.","questScorpPitReportDescription":"That\'s 50! Step on the grey portal in the pit\'s floor to get back up to the fort, and tell Grizzlefuse.","questScorpPitCompleted":"KA-BOOM! Did you see \'em fly? Beautiful! Here, spotter: the Magmaward Gauntlets. Dug \'em out of the pit after a big one. Still warm! And take these Interdimensional Mortar Strikes [[Purple Firecracker Pebble]]. Throw one anywhere, ANYWHERE, and my shells come raining down through a rift right over it!","questDailyScorpDescription":"They\'ve bred back, spotter! Fresh Mortar Strikes [[Red Firecracker Pebble]], same job. You mark \'em, I shell \'em!","questDailyScorpHuntDescription":"Defeat 10 scorpions in the Scorp Pit, with Mortar Strikes [[Red Firecracker Pebble]] or your own weapon.","questDailyScorpReportDescription":"Pit\'s thinned! Take the grey portal in the pit\'s floor back up and tell Grizzlefuse.","questDailyScorpCompleted":"Ha ha! Lovely shooting, spotter. Here, more Interdimensional Mortar Strikes [[Purple Firecracker Pebble]]. Same again?","questScorpPitName":"The Scorp Pit","questScorpPitHunt":"Defeat 50 scorpions in the Scorp Pit","questDailyScorpHunt":"Defeat 10 scorpions in the Scorp Pit","questGrizzlefuseFuelName":"The Pit\'s Flask","questGrizzlefuseFuelDescription":"Spotter! Those thieving scorpions nicked my Splash Poison Potions [[Splash Poison Potion]] and buried \'em in their egg piles! Find me 5 and my spare Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]] is yours. Deal? DEAL!","questGrizzlefuseFuelFind":"Find 5 Splash Poison Potions [[Splash Poison Potion]] in the Scorp Pit\'s egg piles","questGrizzlefuseFuelFindDescription":"Jump down into the Scorp Pit and dig a whole stack of eggs out of its big egg piles. Take the grey portal in the pit\'s floor back up to the fort, and tell Grizzlefuse.","questGrizzlefuseFuelCompleted":"All 5 found? Ha ha! Those scorpions\'ll be fuming! Here, spotter: one Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]. Wear the whole set and it burns up the second lava touches you. I keep a spare at the gate. Bring me 30 Bones [[Bone]] off the plains\' skeletons and it\'s yours.","questWardFuelErrand":"Defeat the skeletons on the plains outside the outpost gate and gather 30 Bones [[Bone]] for Ward.","questWardFuelCollect":"Gather 30 Bones [[Bone]] from the plains\' skeletons","questWardFuelDelivery":"Bring Ward 30 Bones [[Bone]]","questWardFuelHandIn":"Bring the 30 Bones [[Bone]] back to Ward at the outpost gate.","questWardFuelCollectReminder":"{{remaining}} more Bones [[Bone]]. Out past the guards, and mind their arrows.","questWardFuelReminder":"{{remaining}} more Bones [[Bone]], then the flask is yours.","questWardFuelCompleted":"Good haul. Here\'s the flask: one Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]. Wear the whole set and it burns the moment lava touches you. Don\'t waste it on a swim.","questKadeFuelName":"Kade\'s Flask","questKadeFuelDescription":"You\'ll want Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]] for that armour. I have one flask. Earn it. The Warlord\'s retinue keeps crawling back into my tower. Put down 15 of them.","questKadeFuelHunt":"Defeat 15 of the Warlord\'s retinue in the Tower of Doom","questKadeFuelHuntDescription":"Climb the Tower of Doom and defeat 15 of the Doom Warlord\'s retinue: Cinder Squires, Gauntlet Brutes or Glass Curators.","questKadeFuelReport":"Return to Kade","questKadeFuelReportDescription":"Head back down to Kade at the Tower of Doom\'s door.","questKadeFuelCompleted":"Fifteen. Good. Here. One Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]. Burn it well.","questMortimusFuelName":"The Keeper\'s Flask","questMortimusFuelDescription":"The crypt\'s Mummies wake restless, and the crypt grows uneasy with them. Lay 10 of them back to rest, and I shall part with a flask of Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]] I have kept for longer than you would believe.","questMortimusFuelHunt":"Defeat 10 Mummies in the Shuffling Crypt","questMortimusFuelHuntDescription":"Speak to Mortimus to go down into the Shuffling Crypt, and defeat 10 Mummies as they climb out of its floors.","questMortimusFuelReport":"Return to Mortimus","questMortimusFuelReportDescription":"Return to Mortimus in the crypt\'s hall.","questMortimusFuelCompleted":"The crypt sleeps easier. As promised: one Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]. It burned in these halls before your outpost had a gate.","magmawardFuelBurned":"Burn blocked! {{fuel}} fuel left","magmawardFuelLast":"Burn blocked! That was your last fuel!","magmawardFuelEmpty":"Out of Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]!
