Wear the full Magmaward to survive Cinderfall\'s crater.","questIntoCinderfallDescription":"Our mage was headed for Cinderfall, the volcano north of the plains. Put on every piece of the Magmaward and jump into its crater. Its fire cannot burn you then, but the lava below will once your Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]] runs out. Go, traveller. Find our mage.","questIntoCinderfallJumpDescription":"Climb Cinderfall, north of the plains, to the lookout on its crater\'s rim. Wear all five Magmaward pieces, then jump in.","questIntoCinderfallMageDescription":"Find Ember, the fire mage from Maverick\'s guild, in the Molten Rift below Cinderfall\'s crater.","questIntoCinderfallName":"Into Cinderfall","questIntoCinderfallJump":"Jump into Cinderfall\'s crater wearing the full Magmaward","questIntoCinderfallMage":"Find Ember in the Molten Rift","ignusNothingToDo":"The crack is quiet. I\'ll keep an eye on it.","ignusQuestGreeting":"Mind the edge. That isn\'t water down there.","ignusInventoryFull":"Your pack\'s full. Make some room, then come back to me.","outpostGuardNothingToDo":"Eyes on the plains. The Warden\'s orders.","outpostGuardQuestGreeting":"Traveller. Mind the road out there.","mortimusNothingToDo":"The crypt is stirring, and will not take you yet. Ask me again in a moment, traveller.","mortimusQuestGreeting":"Another traveller. The crypt has been expecting you.","mortimusInventoryFull":"Your pack is full, traveller. Make some room, then come back to me.","mortimusIncantation":"Vesh nakhu, oru semet... Khaba telluret, an sheru dav!","questShufflingCryptName":"The Shuffling Crypt","questShufflingCryptDescription":"Beneath us lies the Shuffling Crypt. In the vault at its far end rest the Magmaward Boots, and they are yours if you can reach them. Speak to me when you are ready, and I will send you down.","questShufflingCryptEscape":"Claim the Magmaward Boots from the Shuffling Crypt\'s vault","questShufflingCryptEscapeDescription":"Speak to me, and I will send you down. The rooms will shift to lose you, so follow my ghostly fennec to the vault at the far end. The Boots wait there.","questDailyCryptName":"The Crypt Stirs","questDailyCryptDescription":"The crypt has shifted in the night, and its vault holds fresh spoils. Speak to me when you are ready, traveller, and I will send you down to claim them.","questDailyCryptEscape":"Claim the spoils from the Shuffling Crypt\'s vault","questDailyCryptEscapeDescription":"Speak to me, and I will send you down. Follow my ghostly fennec through the shifting rooms to the vault, and claim what waits there.","questDailyCryptReport":"Return to Mortimus","questDailyCryptReportDescription":"The crypt has let you go. Return to Mortimus in its hall.","questDailyCryptCompleted":"You walked out of the dark once more. By tomorrow, the crypt will have shifted again.","questDailyCryptDone":"You have done what I asked of you today, traveller. The crypt is stirring, but ask me again in a moment and I will send you down once more.","questSlayVulcanDescription":"You came through the fire? I\'m Ember. I felt a crack open in the world and followed it down. It\'s Lord Vulcan\'s doing, a wizard gone bad. He\'s been tearing it open from his tower at the bottom of the rift, and my fire only feeds him. His spells come in time, like a drum. Learn the beat and you can beat him. Bring friends if you can.","questSlayVulcanFightDescription":"Defeat Lord Vulcan in the ring at the bottom of the Molten Rift. His big spells come in time: step with the beat, or get out of the ring until they pass. Anyone fighting him beside you shares the win.","questSlayVulcanReportDescription":"Lord Vulcan is beaten! Tell Ember at the rift\'s southern edge.","questSlayVulcanCompleted":"You did it! Lord Vulcan is beaten, and the crack has gone quiet. But it isn\'t the only one. More are opening all over the land, and he wasn\'t working alone. When the next one opens, I\'ll need you again.","questSlayVulcanName":"Lord Vulcan","questSlayVulcanFight":"Defeat Lord Vulcan in the Molten Rift","questSlayVulcanReport":"Return to Ember","lordVulcanTauntKneel":"Kneel, and I may let you watch the world burn.","lordVulcanTauntTower":"You stand in my tower now.","lordVulcanTauntPatience":"Patience. The fire always comes.","lordVulcanTauntPitiful":"Pitiful.","lordVulcanTauntAscend":"Enough! Behold my true power!","lordVulcanTauntEnough":"You think you\'ve hurt me? I\'ve only begun!","lordVulcanTauntDance":"Keep time, little one!","lordVulcanTauntRhythm":"In, out, in, out!","lordVulcanTauntSunder":"Let the world split open!","lordVulcanTauntKeepUp":"Keep up, or
